manifest.source: Kimi Code 2.4.1 controlled print-mode census plus a digest-pinned projection of the exact release source. The generated manifest lists 67 durable record types; three engine-journal records and two undo records outside it are inventory-checked against their producers. Unforced branches remain unverified.

argv.notes: Native Kimi process launch and KIMI_CODE_HOME selection.

terminal.notes: Native TUI presentation and guarded input; terminal text is not semantic truth.

hook-command.notes: Configured external hooks receive one JSON document on stdin.

artifacts.fileDescription: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64, version 1 (GNU/Linux), dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, BuildID[sha1]=5e67bdf95c7646325b62decd0ca8d375d325ea19, for GNU/Linux 3.2.0, with debug_info, not stripped, too many notes (256)

claims.harness: isolated KIMI_CODE_HOME with loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, command hooks, multi-invocation resume, detached process task, provider rejection, hook block/deny, HTTP 429 and malformed-SSE step retries, print-mode SIGINT cancellation, and a foreground subagent journal
SHA-256, file identity, --version, --help, rejected-option, and raw-capture tree probes

claims.notes: Digest-pinned exact release source establishes 67 durable record schemas from the generated manifest, 5 engine-journal/undo records outside it, 20 hook schemas, protocol 1.5, and CLI declarations; it does not promote unforced runtime behavior.

limitations: The controlled census is native print mode, including multi-invocation resume, a detached process task, provider rejection, hook block/deny, HTTP 429 and malformed-SSE step retries, print-mode SIGINT cancellation, and a foreground subagent journal; it is not interactive PTY mode.
Runtime evidence covers 43 of 95 modelled surfaces; the remaining 52 are exact-source-only.
Interactive TUI permissions, questions, steer, queueing, Esc-cancel, compaction, undo/branch switching, swarm, tower mode, and non-success process-task or subagent outcomes remain unverified.
Only the linux-x64 release artifact has runtime evidence; this is not a support promotion.
The release source projection preserves recursive declared structure but intentionally leaves custom/unknown values unconstrained; runtime-only file schemas describe captured instances.
